guide.title: How to play
guide.intro: Survive inside the shrinking storm and dodge the tagger. In a pinch, swITch the role onto another runner.

demo.title: What each skill does
demo.manualMotion: Reduced motion is on, so a still frame is shown. Press play to watch once.

dash.body: A long burst of speed. It’s a run, not a teleport, so walls stop you, but you go farther than Flash.

flash.body: Teleport the way you face. Walls in between are ignored; only the landing spot matters. Shortest cooldown of the three.

exhaust.body: Slows everyone in range, so position beats aim. Longest cooldown, and it briefly slows you too.

switch.body: Works only near the tagger. The runner you pick becomes the tagger; you stay a runner and get Frenzy.

tagger.body: The tagger has a red body and a flag overhead. Get caught and you’re out.

rules.title: Survive to the end
rules.tag: Get caught by the tagger and you’re out. It’s the only way out of a match.
rules.storm: The storm keeps closing in and pushes you back, so everyone is forced together.
rules.switch: Switch works only near the tagger. The runner you pick becomes the tagger; you stay a runner.
rules.winners: The last two players alive win together.

training.hint: Try every skill freely. Nothing here counts.

rules.becomeTagger: Becoming the tagger gives {{frenzyPercent}}% more speed for {{frenzySeconds}}s (Frenzy) — at match start, when switched, or on forced rotation.
rules.chainTag: Catching someone in Frenzy adds {{tagBonusSeconds}}s and another {{tagBonusPercent}}% speed. Chain catches to keep speeding up.
rules.switchBonus: Landing a switch gives you the same Frenzy — time to run after passing the role.
rules.demoted: Losing the role to a switch slows you by {{demotedPercent}}% for {{demotedSeconds}}s, so you can’t switch it straight back.
rules.nearCooldown: Runners within {{nearRadiusTiles}} tiles of the tagger recover cooldowns {{nearBonusPercent}}% faster. More risk, more skills.
rules.rotate: If the tagger hasn’t changed for {{rotateSeconds}}s, a random runner becomes the tagger.
